runtime_behavior: All listed fields must be explicitly TRUE before READY in v1.23.
governance_policy: A field may represent an official concept without having an official machine threshold. Field labels must not be interpreted as proof that a numeric or geometric definition is official.

mid_range.safe_interpretation: Poconical targets the initial move of a middle-range formation after the corrective phase rather than the initial reversal move.

lower_right_shoulder.safe_interpretation: Official material strongly supports entering around a W-top/head-and-shoulders right-shoulder area and nested formations. The v1.23 field name 'lower_right_shoulder' is a project review label, not proof of an official universal lower-shoulder numeric threshold.
unresolved: universal requirement that the right shoulder must be strictly lower

inside_dma25x5.safe_interpretation: MA25-5/DMA25x5 is an official Poconical component. No primary machine-safe definition has been found for the v1.23 review phrase 'inside DMA25x5'.
unresolved: whether inside means candle body, wick, close, open, or all rates
universal AND/OR relationship with formation/Fibonacci evidence

ma_path_clear.safe_interpretation: Official material treats MA-sand / obstructing MA context as relevant to whether an entry has attractive room. The exact clearance threshold is not officialized as a machine number.
unresolved: which MA set is universally blocking in every setup

has_room.safe_interpretation: Official material explicitly values room in the trade direction in addition to MA angle/context. No universal pips/ATR threshold is currently grounded.

upper_environment_valid.safe_interpretation: Higher-timeframe environment recognition is an official prerequisite. The existing H1 WATCH automation is a research proxy and must not be treated as the official environment rule itself.
